items.title: National Restaurant Building and Equipment Standards
Federal, State, County, Municipal Zoning, Building, Health, OSHA.  Note:  Project Manager should inform of any special requirements.
Constructed and Operational in 1992 or later. Restaurant must be in total compliance with ADA guidelines including all remodels done during this timeframe.

Constructed and Operational prior to 1992. 
Restaurant must meet “Readily Achievable” ADA standards by making those alterations that are not “too difficult and not too expensive” to accomplish.
Restaurants built prior to 1992 may be subject to different governmental standards of ADA compliance depending on the condition of the site, available resources, and any remodeling or alterations.
Parking stalls designed to meet local code and optimize lot capacity.
Adequate number of plumbing fixtures as required by local code.

RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that a qualified technician inspect HVAC, 
refrigeration equipment, roof and irrigation system. It is also recommended that a Power 
Audit using CPP documentation, be complete to ensure that the restaurant meets 
McDonald's Power Quality Guidelines.

Adherance to US Technology Standards
The US Technology Standards are foundational requirements, principals and best 
practices that keep our systems running efficiently, safely and securely.

BUILDING / FACILITIES
EBF1 Entrance/Exit directional signage (replace any missing previously installed signs)
EBF 2 Lighting around rear door properly lit and illuminated
EBF 3 Lighting around trash corral properly lit and illuminated
EBF 4 Lighting around outdoor digital menu board(s) properly lit and illuminated
EBF 5 Lighting around drive-thru windows properly lit and illuminated
EBF 6 Soffit lighting and roof beams
EBF7 Parking lot lighting (including poles and bases)
EBF 8 Road sign/reader board (including poles and bases)
EBF 9 Building signage
EBF 10 Parking lot properly graded, surfaced and sealed. Free of obstacles and conditions that could cause a slip or trip
EBF 11 Parking spaces designed for disabled customers driving a vehicle
EBF 12 Clearly marked parking stalls with appropriate striping
EBF 13 Curbs
EBF 14 Walkways
EBF 15 Landscaping

EBF 16 Restaurant has modernized exterior (Arcade Building, Core ’16, Ribbon + Blade or 
BB20 exterior design)
*Walmart locations - Restaurant has modernized exterior (current bulkhead design 
with a minimum of one (1) lit arch sign)
EBF 17  A minimum of two outside trash receptacles available for restaurants with drive-thru
EBF 18  Clear directional flow and lane identification
EBF 19   Drive-thru clearance sign if building has an overhang and/or order points with canopies
EBF 20  A gateway sign or branded canopy
EBF 21 Directional Signage
EBF 22  Two to Three window signs

EBF 23 Curbside signage for Digital Ordering (Delivery, Curbside, MOP, Drive-thru):  - minimum of two Curbside stalls at ingress with approved lot stripe and signage- minimum of two designated drive-thru parking stalls on drive-thru side of building- minimum of one designated stall for Delivery Courier parking required for restaurants 
placed at courier entrance
EBF 24 Pull Forward signage (minimum of two are required)
EBF 25  Diversion (Handrail) at building exit adjacent to the drive-thru lane
EBF 26 Drive-thru Branding should be current US Standard (White decal on charcoal canopy) or Legacy standard (Vertical blade sign)
EBF 27 Trash corral (i.e., gate, walls, plumbing, electrical, pad, and apron)
EBF 28  Dumpsters have lids that fully close
EBF 29  Building exterior structure elements, including storage facilities, are well-maintained and in good condition and repair

EBF 30 Perimeter doors and walk-up windows equipped with functioning locking devices
*Walmart locations - Security gate in good condition, if existing

EBF 31 Panic egress hardware installed on all back of house egress doors and any latching 
doors in the lobby area (thumb lock or keylock cylinder are not considered latching 
devices), and all egress doors are fully operational

EBF 32 Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, etc.) is free from damage and 
potential electrical shock/fire hazards

EE1  Signage provided at speaker order point instructing customers with speech or hearing 
difficulties to pull to the next open window
EE 2 Signage present at one of the drive-thru windows indicating assistance available at this window for hearing/ speech impaired custome

ET1  Outdoor Digital Menu Boards (ODMB) and Digital Pre-Browse boards are approved 
and located appropriately- Coates ODMB enclosure / pre-sell effective 01/01/27- Minimum of two ODMB screens per order point- Up to one Pre-Browse screen per lane

ET 2 Two-booth speaker with an effective and clear communication system: stand-alone 
speakerpost, canopy integrated speaker or ODMB integrated speaker. 
Approved Speakerpost or Canopy includes:- Standalone Speakerposts that do not have integrated COD (Customer Order Display)- Springboard Canopy with or without integrated COD- Arcade Canopy with or without Integrated COD- ODMB Integrated Speakerpost
RRF 1 Plumbing fixtures with either automatic or wing faucets, pipes are covered if exposed
RRF 2 Exhaust fan operating and capable of removing odors
RRF 3 Floors (tile, grout, base tile)
RRF 4 Walls
RRF 5 Ceiling (painted drywall – no lay-in ceilings)
RRF 6 Adequate lighting
RRF 7 Doors and stall partitions
RRF 8 Hand sinks in the restrooms have warm water (will achieve 100°F) and touchless hand soap dispensers. Hot air hand dryers or hands-free towel dispensers present

RRF 9  Emergency and lighting system present and tested (via pushbutton) to verify proper 
operation
DRF 1 Lighting properly illuminated
DRF 2 Lay-in acoustical ceiling and grid or “exposed” ceiling system
DRF 3 Floor tile and base, grout and tile: No quarry, Mardi Gras or Strata tile in Dining Room. All 10-Year Dining Room Remodels will require tile replacement, regardless of existing tile

DRF 4 All restaurants must have a then-approved Global Portfolio design décor package, 
including dining room, front counter and restroom areas that are less than 10 years old

DRF 5  Emergency and exit lighting system present and tested (via pushbutton) to verify 
proper operation

DRF 6  Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, etc.) is free from damage and 
potential electrical shock/fire hazards
DRE 1  PlayPlace elements are maintained in good repair
DRE 2 Indoor/outdoor PlayPlace door(s)/gate(s) have functioning egress alarm installed
DRE 3 Approved Mobile Order & Pay (MOP) Table Markers
DRE 4 Adequate seating designated for disabled customers with the international symbol or accessibility

DRE 5 Self-serve beverage area or crew-poured soft drinks behind the counter.
Note that effective 01/01/33, the following is required for all restaurants:- the self-serve beverage bar removed - crew-poured soft drinks behind the Front Counter- Beverage Landing Zone (BLZ)

DRE 6 Customer conveniences (high chairs, napkin/straw dispensers, condiments, etc.) 
attractive
DRE 7  ABC-class hand-held fire extinguishers (red) are properly installed and meet regulatory requirements
DRT 1  WIFI, a TV and/or music (ADA requirements call for closed captioning to be enabled if TV sound is turned on)
DRT 2 Storm Track Pad for Audio Navigation - minimum 25% of Kiosk faces

DRT 3 Each Kiosk face has a:
- Cashless Payment Entry Device (PED) that is PCI4 compliant (effective 01/01/27 must be PC15 compliant)
Mobile Offer Scanner 
Receipt Printer

DRT 4 Table Service Table Locator Tents:- 
Restaurants with more than 150 seats and/or seating across more than one floor level 
require a Bluetooth Table Service locator system with technology-enabled Table 
Service Tents 
All other restaurants require non-technology enabled Table Service Tents
FCF 1 Continuous or split front counter, either Service Pod or Modular Front Counter

FCF 2 Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, etc.) is free from damage and 
potential electrical shock/fire hazards
FCF 3  Tile walls
FCF 4 Unglazed, abrasive quarry tile floor or treated non-slip surface
FCF 5 Lighting properly illuminated
FCF 6 Vinyl covered board lay-in ceiling and grid – or existing ceiling – Unpainted

FCE 1 McDelivery/Digital: Dedicated Digital Assembly Cart (DAC) is required for all restaurants.Equipment aligned with Be Well Served layout includes:- 
DAC with refrigeration (1 cart needs to have refrigeration) 
3rd Party Delivery Tablets 
Monitor, printer and bump bar 
Delivery bags, napkins, straw holder, marker storage, sticker rolls, condiment bins
FCE 2  ABC-class hand-held fire extinguishers (red) are properly installed and meet regulatory requirements

FTC 1  Front Counter POS Registers:- Non-Elevated Self-Ordering Experience (ESE) Restaurants: minimum two POS registers at Front Counter- ESE Restaurants: One visible POS Register at Front Counter (register #2) and one backup register (register #1) located on Digital Assembly Cart (DAC)

FTC 2  Each front counter register accepting payment has a:  
Receipt Printer- 
Cashless Payment Entry Device (PED)  that is PCI4 compliant (effective 01/01/27 
must be PC15 compliant)- 
Mobile Offer Scanner- 
Cash Drawer
FTC 3 Front Counter Expo Monitor - minimum one
FTC 4 Each Front Counter Expo Monitor has one Picklist Receipt Printe

FTC 5 Approved Indoor Digital Menu Boards (IDMB):- Non-ESE Restaurants minimum three IDMBs (two menu + one merchandiser) behind FC Order Point- ESE Restaurants - two IDMBs standard (zero menu + two merchandisers)

FTC 6 Non-ESE Restaurants
Equipment that supports Dual Point 2.0 Service System, including Order Ready Board 
(ORB), mini-ORB, and Bar Code Scanner,  either operational or decommissioned, 
effective 01/01/26
BDE 1 Automated Beverage System (ABS)

BDE 2 A minimum of two coffee brewers are required in support of front counter and drive
thru.
*Walmart locations - A minimum of one coffee brewer is required in support of front 
counter and drive-thru.

BDE 3 Curtis thermal pots are the only pots approved for serving and holding regular and 
decaf coffee from a Bunn Axiom or Curtis Alpha coffee brewer. Three Curtis thermal 
coffee pots are required for each Axiom or Alpha coffee brewer.

BDE 4 A minimum of one automated cream dispenser and one automated sweetener 
dispenser are required at each coffee brewing station located in drive-thru and front 
counter. (i.e. BDAP cell has only one coffee brewing station for the restaurant)
BDE 5 Specialty  McCafé Coffee Machine
BDE 6 Blended Ice Machine (BIM) or Blend In Cup (BIC)

BDE 7 Juice Dispenser
* Walmart locations bottled orange juice, Juice Dispenser

BDE 8 Shake and Sundae equipment.
For restaurants with Beverage and Dessert as Production (BDAP) cell, a two-tier BLZ 
cart by Shake and Sundae machine is required.
BDE 9 Annual Shake/Sundae Machine certifications and PM verification required
BDE 10  McFlurry spindle and two candy holding containers
BDE 11 Frozen Carbonated Beverage Machine
BDE 12 Pie merchandiser
BDE 13  MIS – tea brewer

BDE 14  For traditional DT restaurants - a minimum of two iced coffee urns, three sweet tea 
urns, and three iced tea urns.                                                               
 *For Non-DT restaurants & Walmart locations - A minimum of two iced coffee urns, 
two sweet tea urns, and two iced tea urns (including lids, and lid locks in self serve 
areas)
BDE 15 Reach-in cooler
BDE 16 NSF-approved commercial Ice bin(s) with a lid installed or available to protect ice from potential contamination effective, 01/01/27

BDT 1 McCafé beverage monitor- 
Non-BDAP restaurants - minimum one- 
BDAP restaurants - minimum two
BDT 2 McCafé Beverage 40mm Sticky Receipt Printer

BDT 3 Restaurants with Front Counter crew poured soft drinks (self-serve beverage bar has 
been removed):- Front Counter Beverage Monitor with bump bar
IDTF 1  Drive-thru windows functioning properly, including ability to lock, automatically close, and not be continuously held open

IDTF 2 Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, OEPs, etc.) is free from damage 
and potential electrical shock/fire hazards
IDTF 3  Tile walls
IDTF 4  Unglazed, abrasive quarry tile floor or treated non-slip surface
IDTF 5  TilLighting properly illuminated
IDTF 6  Vinyl covered board lay-in ceiling and grid – or existing ceiling – Unpainted
IDTE 1 Refrigeration in the DT area for bottled drinks, milk jugs, and juice boxes
IDTT 1 Drive-thru POS Registers - minimum quantity based on configuration-One Order Point (Two Booth Single COD or Single Booth Single COD) - three-Two Order Points (Side-by-Side or Tandem) - four

IDTT 2 Each Register accepting payment has a:- Cash Drawer- Verifone P400 Cashless Payment Entry Device (PED) that is PCI4 compliant (effective 
01/01/27 must be PC15 compliant)- Mobile Offer Scanner
IDTT 3 Drive-thru Receipt Printer located in Cashier Booth or Present Booth
IDTT 4 For Side-by-Side drive-thru:- POS Video Sequencing Cameras- Merge Point Monitor(s) required wherever orders are taken
IDTT 5 Drive-thru Expo Monitor
IDTT 6 Drive-thru Present Monitor
IDTT 7 Danger Zone Monitor
IDTT 8 Drive-thru runner and presenter bump bars

IDTT 9 Digital drive-thru headsets: 
 - Single Order Point minimum of five headsets
 - Tandem or Side-by-Side minimum of seven headsets
KF 1  Tile/FRP walls
KF 2  Unglazed, abrasive quarry tile floor or treated non-slip surface
KF 3  Lighting properly illuminated
KF 4 Vinyl covered board lay-in ceiling and grid – or existing ceiling – Unpainted
KF 5 Supply diffusers positioned over aisles, not over food prep equipment

KF 6 All back-of-house handwash sinks must have automated/sensor or foot/knee-operated faucets and achieve a minimum temperature of 100°F. Other requirements include:- Handwash timing system- Hands-free paper towel dispenser - Touchless hand soap dispenser

KF 7  Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, OEPs, etc.) is free from damage 
and  potential electrical shock/fire hazards

KE 1 OPL/COPL Order Assembly Table (OAT), MFY OAT or HLS for MFY (two HLZs with 
Order Assembly Stand not approved effective 01/01/27).  
*Walmart requires one HLZ or one Heated Landing Surface (HLS) with Order 
Assembly Table (OAT) or Assembly Topper.
KE 2  Euro Fry Station

KE 3 Fryers functioning and have enough fry vats to meet McDonald’s QSC standards, 
support the menu and grow the business
KE 4  Automated Frozen Fry Dispensers
KE 5 Thaw rack(s) for frozen buns - sufficient amount to accommodate proper thawing
KE 6 Bun Rack

KE 7 Two Qing Ovens.  One standard Qing Oven and one On Cue, or two standard Qing 
ovens (restaurants with only On Cue are unable to follow approved operational 
procedures).  
*Walmart locations require one Qing Oven.
KE 8 Muffin/bagel toaster (Q-ing oven) stand

KE 9 Universal Toaster and one HEMT Muffin Toaster or one Regular menu and one 
Breakfast Horizontal Toaster (ability to toast two-sided Big Mac club)
KE  10 Toaster table
KE 11 Filet Steamer
KE 12 Convection oven or Combi Oven (Combi Oven requires a ventless/vented hood)
KE 13 A minimum of one multi-product fryer front is required when only two vats are available for white meat production

KE 14 Two Clamshell grills (Use grill capacity tool to determine actual need beyond four 
platens)
* Walmart locations - one Clamshell grill (Use grill capacity tool to determine actual 
need beyond two platens)
KE 15 Annual Grill certifications and PM verification required

KE 16 Grill-side meat freezer(s) with minimum capacity to hold two cases 10:1 and a two 
drawer grill-side meat cooler that supports 4:1 fresh beef.  
*Walmart requires grill-side meat freezer(s) with minimum capacity to hold one case of 
10:1 and a grill-side cooler that supports 4:1 fresh beef.

KE 17 High Capacity Prep table (prep line is the same height as HLZ/HLS for operational 
efficiency)
KE 18 UHC heated table dual-sided

KE 19 UHCs - (capacity to support two trays for each item held, with the exception of 
Canadian bacon (one tray). Minimum 36 slots. Use UHC capacity tool to determine 
actual need beyond 36 slots)
KE 20 Simplified Breakfast Holding Cabinet

KE 21  Refrigerated storage sufficient to hold prep ingredients within 10 feet in the primary 
initiator position
KE 22 Frozen storage sufficient to hold frozen products in the kitchen area
KE  23 Frozen storage sufficient to hold frozen products in the kitchen area

KE  24  Ansul Automatic UL-300 R-102 Wet Chemical System and K-class hand-held fire 
extinguishers (silver) are properly installed and inspected to meet regulatory 
requirements
KE  25 Cooking equipment fire suppression pull stations clearly and permanently labeled

KE  26  ABC-class hand-held fire extinguishers (red) are properly installed and meet regulatory 
requirements

KT 1  Prep Line KVS Monitors
For Traditional MFY, Optimized Prep Line (OPL) or Compact Optimized Prep Line 
(COPL) prep lines:- For each side of the prep line, one Breakfast Monitor and one Lunch Monitor (i.e., two per side)
For Hub & Spoke prep lines:- Minimum of two Initiation Points, each with one Breakfast Monitor and one Lunch 
Monitor (i.e., four monitors total)- Additional Initiation Points, each with a minimum of one Lunch Monitor (i.e., one per Initiation Point)
Each Prep Line KVS Monitor has:
 - Bump Bar
 - Dedicated Grill Slip Printer (AKA Side Specific Grill Printer)
KT 2 Grill Monitor with two Bump Bars & Speaker
KT 3 Electronic food freshness labeling system for raw and finished product hold times

KT 4 Production System, including-  
UHC Monitor with bump bar- 
Fry Monitor- 
Bake Monitor with bump bar and receipt printer

KT 5 Approved Digital Food Safety program with a functioning pyrometer & backup 
pyrometer with batteries, and includes the following attachments:- 
Food and beverage probe- 
Grill surface probe- 
Shortening probe- 
UHC probe- 
Oven prob
SF 1 All back of house egress doors have proper panic egress hardware installed
SF 2 Rear and side delivery operable door alarm - Alarm Lock - PG21MSS

SF 3 All back of house doors in good condition, with unobstructed and working external view device (i.e., peephole, flap window, video monitor, etc.) on all restricted access doors, 
including rear & side entrance doors

SF 4 Water, Gas, Electrical main cutoffs labeled and tool for turning off gas is readily 
accessible (if required)

SF 5  Emergency and exit lighting system present and tested (via pushbutton) to verify 
proper operation
SF 6  Interior and exterior roof ladder(s), ladder access, roof access, and pathways are safe
SF 7  Roof surface without clutter
SF 8  Exhaust fans, belts, and motors operating
SF 9 MAC unit operating
SF 10 Commercial Water Heater, effective 01/01/27

SF 11  Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, etc.) is free from damage and 
potential electrical shock/fire hazards
SF 12 CO2 detectors, horn/strobe units, and central unit are properly installed per McDonald's standards
SF 13 Tile/FRP walls
SF 14 Unglazed, abrasive quarry tile floor or treated non-slip surface
SF 15 Lighting properly illuminated
SF 16 Vinyl covered board lay-in ceiling and grid – or existing ceiling – Unpainted
SE 1 Stand-alone ice machine
SE 2  Washing machine required; clothes dryer - if required by local code

SE 4 Approved warewasher, effective 01/01/27
SE  5  Minimum of two Bulk Coke tanks required for restaurants utilizing bulk Coke

SE 6 Portable cylinder(s), Bulk CO2, and Bulk Coke tanks properly installed with no storage

SE  7 All water systems must meet the minimum equipment requirements referenced in the 
Global Water Quality Manual, including but not limited to: filtration systems, reverse 
osmosis systems, manifolds, panels and line sizes. 
*Walmart requires all water systems must have approved water filtration equipment 
effective 01/01/26
SE  8 Shortening filtration disposal equipment, shortening disposal cart
SE  9  ABC-class hand-held fire extinguishers (red) are properly installed and meet regulatory requirements
SE  10 Walk-in cooler
SE  11 Walk-in Freezer
SE  12 Approved commercial shelving in dry storage, effective 01/01/28

ST 1  Minimum of 11 Remote Temperature Sensors which includes one in the walk-in 
freezer and all refrigerator/coolers which hold food.  
*Walmart locations - Adequate number of Remote Temperature Sensors which 
includes one in the walk-in freezer and all refrigerator/coolers which hold food
RAOF 1  Walls, ceiling, floors, and lighting in crew area in good repair
RAOF 2 Walls, ceiling, floors, and lighting in office in good repair

RAOF 3 HVAC units functioning.  System capable of maintaining 68°F in winter, 78°F in 
summer

RAOF 4 Electrical power system (e.g., outlets, plugs, cords, etc.) is free from damage and 
potential electrical shock/fire hazards
RAOE 1  Rest area dedicated to crew – comfortable, and with seating, clock, and mirrior
RAOE 2  Plaque or poster identifying name of franchisee organization employing workers at that restaurant
RAOE 3 Office equipment and furniture in good repair
RAOE  4 Carbon Dioxide (CO2) alarm system
RAOE 5 First Aid Kit meets O&T requirements
RAOE 6  Office Safe

RAOT 1 Current OS (Operating System) Windows 10 LTSB
Effective 10/1/25 Windows 10 LTSC or higher

RAOT 2 Current Server Operating System - Windows Server 2016 or higher
Effective 01/01/27 Windows Server 2022 or higher
RAOT 3 Current POS (Sesame) Software Version - 12.0 or higher
RAOT  4  Minimum of one Tablet or computer dedicated to training, which includes training that enables digital employee engagement tools (HU Online and CAMPUS)

RAOT 5 Approved Technology Rack, in Manager's Office or Technology Closet:
Stationary Rack- 82" Stationary Rack (aka Cooper B-Line)- Eaton 45U SR4POST
or 14" (8U) Wall Mounted Network Rack & Rolling Rack- 77" Rolling Rack (aka Paragon Rolling Rack)- Hammond C2 Series C2F196323- Middle Atlantic ERK-4020LRD

RAOT  6 Video Security Camera System (migration from Analog-CCTV to IP-CCTV required by 01/01/27), At least 90 days of storage of the office camera and 60 days of storage for 
the remainder of the restaurant cameras with camera views of the parking lot, pull 
forward, curbside, vehicle license plate, lobby, lobby entrance, PlayPlace, front counter, 
cash booth, presenter's booth, office, back door, side door, trash corral, crew room, 
and freezer.

RAOT  7 Approved Restaurant Network
2026 - RNT (AT&T / Aruba) or GRNT (Accenture / Juniper)
Effective 07/01/27 - GRNT (Accenture / Juniper)

RAOT  8  Approved DMB Content Management System (CMS)
2026 - Stratacache or Coates
Effective 01/01/27 - Coates
RAOT  9  Edge (Google Cloud Edge) Server Platform effective 01/01/28
